name: Addis Sata
source:
Addis is the current King of Sata. He chooses to preserve his nation through harsh politics meant to punish the weak and downtrodden. Addis sees all his subjects as his pawns.

[From [url=https://court-of-darkness.fandom.com/wiki/Addis_Ira]Fandom Wiki[/url]]
